app.name: Beredskap
app.tagline: skyddsrum.se for property owners, county boards and municipalities
app.demoNotice: Demo environment with fictional organisations and statuses.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
login.notConfigured: The app is not configured. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

home.signOutDrafts: You have {count} unsent drafts on this device. They will be deleted if you sign out. Sign out anyway?
home.noMembership: Your account is not linked to an organisation. Contact your administrator.
home.loadFailed: Could not load data. Please try again.
home.empty: No shelters are linked to your organisation yet.

check.placeholder: This checklist is a placeholder until MCF or the county board issues the official one.
check.intro: {count} items, one at a time. Everything is saved on the phone until you submit, even without a signal.
check.inspectorName: Your name (the person doing the inspection)
check.discardConfirm: Discard the draft and all its photos? This cannot be undone.
check.photoRequired: A photo is required for a deficiency.
check.photoFailed: Could not read the image. Try another photo.
check.commentPlaceholder: What did you see? What needs fixing?
check.summaryHint: Tap an item to change it.
check.incomplete: Every item needs a status, and every deficiency a photo.
check.offline: No connection. The draft is saved on the phone. Try again when you have a signal.
check.noShelter: The shelter does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
check.needOnline: No connection. Open the inspection once while you have a signal; after that it works offline.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.pdfFailed: Could not create the PDF. Please try again.
receipt.notFound: The receipt does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

shelter.notFound: The shelter does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

maintenance.title: Maintenance log
maintenance.intro: Dated entries show the shelter is looked after. A saved entry cannot be changed; a mistaken entry is voided with a reason.
maintenance.exportFailed: The export failed. Please try again.
maintenance.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: replaced the ventilation filters, greased the door hinges.
maintenance.discardConfirm: Discard the unsaved entry and its photos?
maintenance.voidReason: Why should this entry be voided?
maintenance.offline: No connection. The entry is saved on the phone. Try again when you have a signal.
maintenance.dateInvalid: The date must be today or within the last two years.
maintenance.pdfNote: Done = date given by the owner. Registered = when the entry was saved, set by the server. Entries cannot be changed afterwards; voided entries are shown with the reason.

readiness.title: 48-hour plan
readiness.intro: At heightened alert, shelters must be made ready within 48 hours. The plan says who does what, and by when.
readiness.templateNote: The tasks are a placeholder template until official guidance is available.
readiness.noPlanCaretaker: No plan yet. A property owner can create it.

simulation.title: Activate heightened alert
simulation.explain: Exercise: starts a 48-hour countdown for all your shelters and tracks the tasks live. This is not a real heightened alert and no messages are sent.
simulation.confirmStart: Start a SIMULATION of heightened alert for the whole organisation? It is an exercise; no messages are sent to anyone.
simulation.running: Simulation running. Not a real heightened alert.
simulation.confirmEnd: End the simulation? The result is kept.

contacts.title: Contact people
contacts.intro: Responsible and backup people for the tasks. We only store name, phone, email and role.
contacts.confirmDelete: Remove {name}? They are removed from every task. This cannot be undone.
contacts.name: Name

readiness.ownersOnly: The plan is only available to property owners.

lst.cardIntro: Map and table of every shelter in the county: orders, submitted inspections and review.
lst.forbidden: The overview is only available to county board case officers.
lst.title: Shelters in {lan}
lst.mapHint: Click a shelter to select it. Hold Shift and drag to select an area.

order.title: Order a simplified inspection
order.selectedNoOwner: {count} of them have no registered owner and will be skipped.
order.demoNote: Demo: no emails are sent. Copy the link to each owner.
order.noOwner: {count} shelters have no registered owner and were skipped.
order.alreadyOpen: {count} shelters already had an open order.
order.linksIntro: One unique link per owner. The owner signs in to see their shelters.

review.resultHint: The result follows from the items: a site visit weighs most, then deficiencies.

notice.title: Simplified inspection of shelters
notice.explain: Do a simplified inspection of each shelter below and submit it here. The county board sees the result straight away.
notice.notFound: The order does not exist, or you are signed in with an account that does not belong to the organisation it concerns.

kommun.cardIntro: Share of checked and approved shelters in the municipality, and a map.
kommun.forbidden: The overview is only available to municipality users.
kommun.title: Shelters in {kommun}

level.coarse: Overview: you see whether a shelter is approved or not yet. Deficiencies and photos are not shown. The county board decides what the municipality may see.
level.status: You see each shelter's status, but not which deficiencies there are, nor any photos. The county board decides what the municipality may see.
level.details: The county board has given the municipality access to submitted inspections, deficiencies and photos for shelters in the municipality.

kommun.approvedIntro: Shelters the county board has approved after a simplified inspection. A basis for informing residents.

kommunPolicy.title: What municipalities see
kommunPolicy.intro: Decide what each municipality in the county may see. The default is an overview: approved or not yet, without deficiencies.
kommunPolicy.confirmDetails: Give {kommun} access to submitted inspections, deficiencies and photos?
kommunPolicy.adminOnly: Only county board administrators can change this.
